title: Formation and onboarding forms: the Email box is now the locked portal login email
text: In the formation form, and in the form for a client who already has a company, the Email box used to be editable, so a different email typed there changed only the CRM email, not the email the client logs in with. Now the box shows the real login email and cannot be typed over. A big red block, "Read well before proceeding.", says this is the email used to log in to the client portal, with an "I read it" tick: Next stays grey until it is ticked. A client who already has a company is told to keep the same email for the new one, so one login switches between companies. Submitting the form no longer changes the contact's email.
points: Open the formation form as a client: the Email box shows their login email, locked, with the red block under it
Press Next without ticking "I read it": the block lights up and Next stays grey; tick it and Next turns blue
Open the form as a client who already has a company: the red block also has the paragraph about keeping the same email
Check the CRM contact after a submit: its email has not changed
